title: charter-placed-under-codemother
owner: CC owns the code. Akien owns the design decision (codemother, not cairn).
intention: Place the charter tool instance under codemother — first code ownership transfer from CC to another device. Charter is a building tool; build-quality feedback belongs to the builder. Creates the instance address (devices/codemother/0/tools/charter/0/), wires bus routing so 'charter' resolves to the held instance, and attaches a data_recorder backpack so the instance collects feedback for a sleep-state LLM reader.
why: Surfaced by undelivered bus message (0bfd6e268f73): charter self-addressed a node_class census finding to 'charter' flat, which has no receiver. Charter is a tool (Law 6 — users, not an owner), but a tool INSTANCE needs a holder, and the holder is the one whose feedback loop can act on it. Codemother is the builder; build-quality feedback routes to the builder.
traces_to: feedback-data-recorder — the tool this placement uses
Law 6 — tools have users, not owners; instances have holders
codemother charter — the device that receives ownership

proves_green.prove_gate: proof gate — tester runs the proof: charter instance exists under codemother, bus routes to it, data_recorder instance can receive and be read
proves_green.kicks_back_on: red proof → route back to build

falsifier.proves_red: RED if: (1) no charter tool instance exists under codemother at devices/codemother/0/tools/charter/0/; (2) a bus message addressed to 'charter' does not route to codemother's held instance; (3) the data_recorder instance on charter cannot receive feedback records; (4) the placement makes charter a machine — if it gates writes at its own address or gains glue that interfaces with its operation, the complexity axis was violated.
falsifier.horizon: The sleep-state LLM reader that consumes the data_recorder is a separate ticket (scheduled-llm-gate-inspection); this ticket's scope ends at 'feedback can land and be read', not 'feedback is acted on'.

watchme.trigger: a probe fires feedback about charter quality and a record lands in codemother's held data_recorder instance
watchme.enough: at least one feedback record has been written to and read from the data_recorder instance
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier
watchme.consumer: scheduled-llm-gate-inspection (when built), or manual read in the interim

decisions.text: D-THE-ADDRESS-IS-NAMED-NOT-NUMBERED: falsifier clause (1) spells the held instance at devices/codemother/0/tools/charter/0/ — the trailing /0/ is a mis-translation. CLAUDE.md (the three roots): a device's held tools nest at tools/<name>/, named and never numbered; the chart's validate criteria 1-3 read .../tools/charter/ without a number. The instance lives at devices/codemother/0/tools/charter/ in BOTH roots (class-space charter cairn/devices/codemother/0/tools/charter/intention+why.json; instance-space /home/akien/.cairn/devices/codemother/0/tools/charter/ with instanceizer.json + inbound/). Clause (1) is read as that path.

D-CHARTER-HAS-NO-PRESENCE-OF-ITS-OWN: cairn/tools/charter/shim.py (CharterShim) and device.py (CharterDevice), added 2026-09-02 in c12a480d, made charter a bus device recording at instance_path('charter',0) — a tool with state at its OWN address, which is exactly the machine clause (4) and Law 6 red. Both had zero importers (ground_loop __main__ no longer subscribed it; the only mention was a stale closure listing in a validation already red under 013f8834e0e1). They are retired (bin/cmd/trash). cairn/tools/charter/ keeps its charter, projector, probes, proofs; the bare name 'charter' on the bus now resolves to the held instance. The live /home/akien/.cairn/devices/charter/0/ (202 old records) is untouched — history, not a presence.

D-LANDED (commit follows this line; the hash is in the next D-line): cairn/tools/base/address.py held_tool_paths(tool, roots) — every existing <instance>/devices/*/*/tools/<tool>; cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/bus.py BusDevice._instance_folder(addressee) resolves a folder, a full held-tool address <device>/<n>/tools/<tool>, or a bare tool name held by exactly one device (ambiguous -> None), and _try_folder_delivery uses it; cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py charter_instance(roots), ensure_charter_instance(roots) (instanceizer ensure+load with backpack cairn.tools.data_recorder.data_recorder.DataRecorder at inbound), verb 'charter' (_handle_charter: body.record written with probe_source=sender, body.read N records back, out.records), _handle_activate returns held.charter; cairn/devices/codemother/0/tools/charter/intention+why.json via the artifact door; proof cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_charter_held.py PROVES 1-4; probe cairn/devices/codemother/probes/charter_feedback_reaches.py (PROBE frozen, carry+enough, horizon 500).
